title: 18 Wheeler: American Pro Trucker/Stages
text:
Stage 1
Trailer: Fuel Tanker

New York City to Key West — This is a cruise down Interstate 95.  

 Stage 2  
Trailer: Car transporter/Log Trailer

St. Petersburg to Dallas — This course starts out on a lightly-traveled boulevard.

 Stage 3  
Trailer: Container/Big Rig

Dallas to Las Vegas — The journey continues through the Southwestern desert.  

 Stage 4
Trailer: Dump Trailer/Cable Car

Las Vegas to San Francisco — The final segment of the trip starts out at dawn in Vegas.
